name: Predicta
tagline: Sri Lanka’s AI prediction challenge for undergraduates.
summary: As a pioneering IEEE student branch, we introduced Predicta — an AI prediction challenge with a novel structure where teams apply AI, machine learning and data analytics to real-world problems. With AI and data science as “the new electricity”, Predicta inspires participants to explore and experiment with the technology itself.

sections.heading: Structure of the competition
sections.body: Predicta consists of an awareness session, two knowledge-sharing sessions and the competition itself. The competition is held online: teams receive a real-world dataset and build a model to predict how the data evolves up to a given time frame. Predictions are evaluated against the actual evolution of the real data — so models must be innovative and accurately trained in limited time.

sections.heading: Workshops
sections.body: Predicta 1.0 featured two workshops to help teams gain the edge.

points.text: Workshop 01 — Mr. Mahesha Viduranga, Research Assistant, Multidisciplinary AI Research Centre (MARC), University of Peradeniya.
Workshop 02 — Dr. Kaneeka Vidanage, Senior Lecturer, General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University.

sections.heading: Winners of Predicta 1.0
sections.body: Congratulations to every team that made the leaderboard.

points.text: Winner — Janeesha Wickramasinghe, University of Moratuwa
1st runner-up — Team Optima, University of Colombo School of Computing
2nd runner-up — Team Datadragons, Informatics Institute of Technology

sections.heading: Rules & eligibility
sections.body: Predicta is open to undergraduates of universities in Sri Lanka.

points.text: Teams of up to three members; individual participation is also accepted.
All team members must represent the same university, with proof of studentship if required.
Each team designates a team leader as the primary contact.
There is no limit on the number of teams from the same university.
